description.en: A one-take performance that turns each lyric beat into a new typographic space.
description.zh: 用一镜到底的演出，把每个歌词节拍变成新的字体空间。

prompt: Create a continuous 15-second performance film using the singer in Image 1 and the audio in Audio 1. Preserve the performer's face, hairstyle, wardrobe silhouette, and lip movement throughout. Start in a black rehearsal room with one hard overhead spotlight. Every major vocal beat should physically transform one lyric phrase into part of the set: letters rise from the floor, wrap around the performer, then break into luminous particles. Keep the camera on a controlled circular dolly move with no cuts. Use high-contrast white typography with acid-lime accents, subtle film grain, realistic shadows, and restrained motion blur. End on the final lyric locked as a clean centered title while the performer becomes a silhouette behind it. Do not add extra words, logos, subtitles, or watermarks.
